# frontend

> Next.js 16 app: Builder (admin create), Viewer (admin manage), Store (public browse).

## Docs

- [Overview](wiki/overview.md): Routing, auth context, forms, API client, page-by-page flows, testing.

## Source

- App router: `web-ui/src/app/`
- Auth context: `web-ui/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx`
- API client: `web-ui/src/lib/api-client.ts`
- Saga polling: `web-ui/src/lib/hooks.ts`
- Forms: `web-ui/src/components/forms/`
